title: KV-profile orchestrator and deterministic model pinning for heterogeneous sequence distributions
creator: Evelyn Park
description: Build an automated orchestration pipeline that generates per-model KV cache performance profiles across representative sequence-length distributions and exposes deterministic version-pinning metadata so runtime routing, Dedicated and Private deployments can consistently select the correct model+profile combination. The orchestrator should capture cold/warm KV hit curves, warmup latency slopes, memory working set, and end-to-end token latency at target sequence percentiles (p50/p95/p99) for 2k/8k/32k seq buckets. Output artifacts must be signed, versioned, and publishable to the model catalog for runtime consumption.
acceptance_criteria: Automated pipeline that runs profile jobs for new model uploads (CPU/GPU variants) and produces profile artifacts with the required metadata fields: model_hash, tokenizer_hash, max_ctx, quant_profile, seq_distribution_buckets, run_timestamp, artifact_version
Profiles contain KV hit-rate curves, median and tail token latency, memory working set, and a recommended pinning tag (stable|experimental) with a confidence score
Deterministic pinning table produced and stored in model catalog: given (model_id, artifact_version, target_seq_bucket) runtime returns same pinned profile across Hosted/Dedicated/Private
Integration test that validates runtime selects pinned profile for 10 synthetic tenants and observes expected latency within 5% of profiled numbers
Canary rollout plan documented and executed: staging -> 10% prod -> 50% prod, with automatic rollback on 10% regression in p95 latency or 5% increase in per-token cost
Artifact publishing includes provenance links (GitHub PR, CI job, raw perf traces in S3) and automated changelog entry
tasks: Define artifact schema and required metadata fields (backend + catalog contract)
Extend profiler harness to synthesize realistic seq distributions per tenant and record KV warmup traces
Implement orchestrator controller that schedules profile jobs, retries transient failures, and signs artifacts
Add deterministic hashing logic for model+tokenizer+profile -> artifact_version mapping
Wire model catalog API to accept profile artifacts and return pinned profile per lookup
Add e2e integration tests and synthetic workload runner for verification
Create canary rollout playbook and add console alerting rules for regression thresholds
